newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest BUX hits third successive record high.
newsitem.headline: Budapest BUX hits third successive record high.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange extended this week's gains to set the third successive all-time high on Thursday but the pace of rise slowed down, signalling the likely start of a consolidation period, traders said.
The BUX index closed at 3,803.45 points, up 14.23. BUX futures closed lower for five maturities and higher for one.

Spot trading began with prices continuing to rise but later prices came down off the day's peaks due to profit-taking, dollar's weakening and the impact of Wednesday's falling trend on European markets, traders said.
"In early trade the rising trend of the market continued," Andrea Keresztesi of ABN AMRO Hoare Govett said.
"(Pharmaceuticals) Richter and Egis began to rise challenging a correction that some expected," she said. "However, in the second half of trading this correction happened."
Richter and Egis closed lower, at 8,750 forints, down 225, and at 8,800 forints, down 75, respectively.
The smaller securities houses were scared off when prices began to fall, Keresztesi said, adding these houses closed positions, driving prices lower.
